prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a classic, silver metal analog alarm clock sits on a glossy white surface, positioned slightly off-center to the right. The clock features two bells on top and a small hammer between them, evoking a vintage, timeless feel. The face of the clock is white with clear, dark numerals and delicate black hands, with the brand "TIFFANY & CO. NEW YORK" subtly printed near the center. The background is softly blurred, composed of sheer white curtains that diffuse natural daylight, creating a serene, minimalist atmosphere. The color palette is cool and muted, dominated by silvers, whites, and soft grays, with gentle reflections on the surface beneath the clock. The lighting is soft and even, with no harsh shadows, enhancing the calm, contemplative mood. The overall style is clean and cinematic, with a shallow depth of field that draws focus to the clock, suggesting themes of time, stillness, and quiet introspection.
